Hi Alicia — welcome. Short checklist to keep things moving: 

1) Tax & vendor setup: W-9 + completed vendor intake form (link below). Our finance team requires vendor form to route a PO.
2) Legal & privacy: Executed DPA (we can accept your signed copy) OR a DocuSign envelope; any redlines should be flagged to legal@redwood-inference.com.
3) Security evidence: SOC 2 report (PDF or secure link) and current subprocessor list (CSV). If SOC 2 is hosted behind a portal, a stable link + expected expiration date is fine.
4) PO details: Our standard payment term is Net 30. Please provide your billing contact, tax ID / EIN, and preferred invoice email. POs are generated after vendor form is completed and W-9 received.

Upload: please use our vendor portal (https://vendor-portal.redwood-inference.com/upload) or send attachments directly to procurement@redwood-inference.com — whichever is easier.

If you can get the DPA + SOC2 link + subprocessor list to us today, finance will start PO routing. Marcus is copied for PO numbering; Laura will take over billing once intake is complete.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
